avto-vakuum.title: Auto Detailing
avto-vakuum.cardDescription: Full interior cleaning: carpets, seats, trunk, and hard-to-reach corners.
avto-vakuum.metaTitle: Auto Detailing in Qarshi — Avto Vakum
avto-vakuum.metaDescription: Professional auto detailing in Qarshi — full cleaning of interior, carpets, seats, and trunk. Open 24/7 — call now!
paragraphs: Auto detailing is a full, deep interior cleaning service: carpets, seats (fabric and leather), panel gaps, door pockets, the trunk, and hard-to-reach corners — all cleaned with powerful industrial equipment and professional chemistry.

The process combines dry and wet cleaning: loose dirt is vacuumed out first, then special chemical solutions remove stains and odors. It takes about 40 minutes per car on average, depending on the interior's condition.
It suits everyone — from daily drivers to those returning from a long trip or getting their car ready for sale. Once it's done, the interior looks and smells brand new.
We're located in central Qarshi, at the intersection by the traffic light, open 24 hours a day with no days off — no appointment needed.

kuzov-kassa-prav.title: Paintless Dent Repair
kuzov-kassa-prav.cardDescription: Paintless dent removal and body geometry restoration.
kuzov-kassa-prav.metaTitle: Paintless Dent Repair in Qarshi — Avto Vakum
kuzov-kassa-prav.metaDescription: Paintless dent repair in Qarshi — we fix dents without damaging the factory paint. Fast, high-quality, available 24/7. Call now!
paragraphs: Paintless dent repair (PDR) is a method of removing dents and impact marks from the body without damaging the paint — special tools are used from behind the panel to gently push or pull the dent flat.

Since the paint layer stays intact, the car's factory finish is never disturbed — this preserves both its appearance and resale value, and the whole process is much faster and cheaper than conventional repainting.
From small door-ding dents to larger damage from hail or a collision — we handle most cases. Small jobs take a few hours; more complex ones are done within a day.
Our craftsmen, with more than 7 years of experience, handle this work in Qarshi with great care. We're located at the intersection by the traffic light and open 24/7.

palirovka.title: Polishing
palirovka.cardDescription: Exterior polishing — we remove fine scratches and dullness.
palirovka.metaTitle: Car Polishing in Qarshi — Avto Vakum
palirovka.metaDescription: Professional car polishing in Qarshi — we remove fine scratches and dullness, restoring the body's original shine. Open 24/7.
paragraphs: Polishing is a step-by-step treatment of the car body's surface that removes fine swirl marks, oxidation, and dullness. The result is paint that regains its original deep color and shine.

The work is done in several stages using special polishing compounds and machine buffers — starting with a coarser abrasive and finishing with a fine final polish. Each panel is treated individually and carefully.

Over time, sun exposure, car-wash brushes, and everyday use leave fine scratches on the body — polishing removes these marks and brings back that "like-new" look. It's also typically done before applying a ceramic coating.
The job takes about a day, depending on the car's condition. We're located in central Qarshi and open 24/7 — call us and we'll arrange a time that works for you.

keramika.title: Ceramic Coating
keramika.cardDescription: Ceramic coating: long-lasting protection, deep gloss, and easier washing.
keramika.metaTitle: Ceramic Coating in Qarshi — Avto Vakum
keramika.metaDescription: Ceramic coating in Qarshi — we give your paint long-lasting protection and a deep shine. Washing becomes easier. Open 24/7.
paragraphs: Ceramic coating is a nano-layer applied over the paint that protects the body from water, dirt, UV rays, and chemical exposure for a long time. It bonds tightly with the paint, giving it a deep, glass-like shine.
On a coated body, water droplets simply bead up and roll off instead of sticking — this makes washing the car much easier and reduces how much dirt clings to it.
For the best result, ceramic coating is usually applied after polishing — the surface is leveled first, so the coating goes on smooth and even. The protection lasts for months, sometimes even years.
At our center in Qarshi, by the traffic light, we work with professional-grade chemicals and equipment. Open 24/7 — we'll confirm price and timing by phone.
